+from collections import deque
+from math import floor
+
+from AlgorithmImports import *
+
+
+class IndependentDailyStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
+    def initialize(self):
+        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.set_cash(1_000_000)
+
+        tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
+        self.symbols = {
+            ticker: self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol
+            for ticker in tickers
+        }
+
+        self.closes = {
+            ticker: deque(maxlen=101)
+            for ticker in tickers
+        }
+        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(
+            self.symbols["AAPL"],
+            14,
+            MovingAverageType.WILDERS,
+            Resolution.DAILY,
+        )
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
+        bars = {}
+        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
+            if data.bars.contains_key(symbol):
+                bar = data.bars[symbol]
+                bars[ticker] = bar
+                self.closes[ticker].append(float(bar.close))
+
+        # Rules are evaluated only when every subscription supplied today's bar.
+        if len(bars) != len(self.symbols):
+            return
+
+        spy_crosses_above = False
+        spy_crosses_below = False
+        spy_closes = self.closes["SPY"]
+        if len(spy_closes) == 101:
+            values = list(spy_closes)
+            yesterday_sma = sum(values[:100]) / 100
+            today_sma = sum(values[1:]) / 100
+            yesterday_close = values[-2]
+            today_close = values[-1]
+            spy_crosses_above = (
+                yesterday_close <= yesterday_sma and today_close > today_sma
+            )
+            spy_crosses_below = (
+                yesterday_close >= yesterday_sma and today_close < today_sma
+            )
+
+        aapl_closes = self.closes["AAPL"]
+        aapl_red_for_three_days = (
+            len(aapl_closes) >= 4
+            and aapl_closes[-1] < aapl_closes[-2]
+            and aapl_closes[-2] < aapl_closes[-3]
+            and aapl_closes[-3] < aapl_closes[-4]
+        )
+
+        # Evaluate every sell before any buy.
+        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
+            self.market_order(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.spy_lot)
+            self.spy_lot = 0
+
+        if (
+            self.aapl_lot > 0
+            and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
+            and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60
+        ):
+            self.market_order(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.aapl_lot)
+            self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
+            quantity = self.calculate_order_quantity(self.symbols["SPY"], 0.40)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self.market_order(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)
+                self.spy_lot = quantity
+
+        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and aapl_red_for_three_days:
+            cash_to_invest = 20_000
+            if self.portfolio.cash >= cash_to_invest:
+                quantity = floor(cash_to_invest / float(bars["AAPL"].close))
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self.market_order(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)
+                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

+            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

+        indicators_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
+

+            if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
+                self.MarketOrder(aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
+                self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+            if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
+                quantity = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) // spy_close)
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self.MarketOrder(spy, quantity)
+                    self.spy_lot = quantity
+
+            if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
+                cash_to_invest = 20_000
+                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= cash_to_invest:
+                    quantity = int(cash_to_invest // aapl_close)
+                    if quantity > 0:
+                        self.MarketOrder(aapl, quantity)
+                        self.aapl_lot = quantity
+
+        if spy_close is not None:
+            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
+            self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma

                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma

from collections import deque
from math import floor

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.aapl = self.add_equity("AAPL", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.ibm = self.add_equity("IBM", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.bac = self.add_equity("BAC", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.aig = self.add_equity("AIG", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS)

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        spy_sma = None
        spy_close = None
        if self.spy in data.bars:
            spy_close = data.bars[self.spy].close
            self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)
            if len(self.spy_closes) == self.spy_closes.maxlen:
                spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / len(self.spy_closes)

        aapl_close = None
        if self.aapl in data.bars:
            aapl_close = data.bars[self.aapl].close
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.aapl_rsi.update(data.bars[self.aapl].end_time, aapl_close)

        complete_bar_set = all(symbol in data.bars for symbol in self.symbols)
        if not complete_bar_set:
            if spy_close is not None:
                self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
                self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma
            if aapl_close is not None:
                self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
            return

        spy_crossed_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

+        all_bars_present = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)
+
+        # Market-state calculations continue whenever their own ticker has a bar,

                self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma

+from AlgorithmImports import *
+from collections import deque
+from decimal import Decimal
+from math import floor
+
+
+class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
+    def Initialize(self):
+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.symbols = {}
+        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
+            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
+
+        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=101)
+        self.aapl_previous_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+        self.pending_orders = {}
+
+    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
+        bars = data.Bars
+
+        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
+        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
+
+        if bars.ContainsKey(spy):
+            self.spy_closes.append(float(bars[spy].Close))
+
+        if bars.ContainsKey(aapl):
+            aapl_close = bars[aapl].Close
+            if self.aapl_previous_close is None:
+                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            elif aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
+                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+            else:
+                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close
+            self.aapl_rsi.Update(IndicatorDataPoint(data.Time, aapl_close))
+
+        if any(not bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
+            return
+
+        self._evaluate_spy(bars[spy])
+        self._evaluate_aapl(bars[aapl])
+
+    def _evaluate_spy(self, bar: TradeBar):
+        symbol = self.symbols["SPY"]
+        if len(self.spy_closes) < 101 or symbol in self.pending_orders:
+            return
+
+        closes = list(self.spy_closes)
+        today_close = closes[-1]
+        yesterday_close = closes[-2]
+        today_sma = sum(closes[-100:]) / 100.0
+        yesterday_sma = sum(closes[-101:-1]) / 100.0
+
+        crosses_below = yesterday_close >= yesterday_sma and today_close < today_sma
+        crosses_above = yesterday_close <= yesterday_sma and today_close > today_sma
+
+        if self.spy_lot > 0:
+            if crosses_below:
+                self._submit_lot_order(symbol, -self.spy_lot, "spy")
+        elif crosses_above:
+            quantity = floor(float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40 / float(bar.Close))
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self._submit_lot_order(symbol, quantity, "spy")
+
+    def _evaluate_aapl(self, bar: TradeBar):
+        symbol = self.symbols["AAPL"]
+        if not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady or symbol in self.pending_orders:
+            return
+
+        if self.aapl_lot > 0:
+            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > Decimal(60):
+                self._submit_lot_order(symbol, -self.aapl_lot, "aapl")
+        elif self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and self.Portfolio.Cash >= Decimal(20_000):
+            quantity = floor(20_000 / float(bar.Close))
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self._submit_lot_order(symbol, quantity, "aapl")
+
+    def _submit_lot_order(self, symbol: Symbol, quantity: int, lot_name: str):
+        ticket = self.MarketOrder(symbol, quantity, False, lot_name)
+        if ticket.Status not in (OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
+            self.pending_orders[symbol] = ticket.OrderId
+
+    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event: OrderEvent):
+        if order_event.Status not in (OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled, OrderStatus.Filled,
+                                      OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
+            return
+
+        order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(order_event.OrderId)
+        if order is None:
+            return
+
+        if order.Tag == "spy":
+            self.spy_lot += int(order_event.FillQuantity)
+        elif order.Tag == "aapl":
+            self.aapl_lot += int(order_event.FillQuantity)
+
+        if order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
+            self.pending_orders.pop(order_event.Symbol, None)

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):

        spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)

            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below:

+class IndependentDailyStrategiesAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
+    def Initialize(self):
+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.symbols = {}
+        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
+            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
+
+        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
+        self.spy_previous_close = None
+        self.spy_previous_sma = None
+
+        self.aapl_previous_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)
+
+        self.lots = {"A": 0, "B": 0}
+        self.pending_orders = {"A": None, "B": None}
+        self.order_strategies = {}
+
+    def OnData(self, data):
+        spy_bar = self._bar_or_none(data, self.symbols["SPY"])
+        aapl_bar = self._bar_or_none(data, self.symbols["AAPL"])
+
+        spy_crosses_above = False
+        spy_crosses_below = False
+        if spy_bar is not None:
+            self.spy_closes.append(float(spy_bar.Close))
+            current_sma = None
+            if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
+                current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0
+
+            if self.spy_previous_sma is not None and current_sma is not None:
+                spy_crosses_above = (
+                    self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
+                    and float(spy_bar.Close) > current_sma
+                )
+                spy_crosses_below = (
+                    self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma
+                    and float(spy_bar.Close) < current_sma
+                )
+
+            self.spy_previous_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
+            self.spy_previous_sma = current_sma
+
+        if aapl_bar is not None:
+            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
+            if self.aapl_previous_close is None:
+                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            elif aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
+                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+            else:
+                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close
+            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)
+
+        # Market-state values above advance whenever their own bars exist.  Trading
+        # rules, however, are skipped unless every subscription supplied a bar.
+        if any(self._bar_or_none(data, symbol) is None for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
+            return
+
+        if self.spy_previous_sma is None or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
+            return
+
+        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
+        if self.lots["A"] > 0 and self.pending_orders["A"] is None:
+            if spy_crosses_below:
+                self._submit("A", self.symbols["SPY"], -self.lots["A"], "A sell")
+
+        if self.lots["B"] > 0 and self.pending_orders["B"] is None:
+            if float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60.0:
+                self._submit("B", self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.lots["B"], "B sell")
+
+        if self.lots["A"] == 0 and self.pending_orders["A"] is None:
+            if spy_crosses_above:
+                quantity = self.CalculateOrderQuantity(self.symbols["SPY"], 0.40)
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self._submit("A", self.symbols["SPY"], quantity, "A buy")
+
+        if self.lots["B"] == 0 and self.pending_orders["B"] is None:
+            if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000.0:
+                quantity = floor(20_000.0 / float(aapl_bar.Close))
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self._submit("B", self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity, "B buy")
+
+    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
+        strategy = self.order_strategies.get(order_event.OrderId)
+        if strategy is None:
+            return
+
+        if order_event.FillQuantity != 0:
+            self.lots[strategy] += int(order_event.FillQuantity)
+
+        if order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
+            self.pending_orders[strategy] = None
+            del self.order_strategies[order_event.OrderId]
+
+    def _submit(self, strategy, symbol, quantity, tag):
+        ticket = self.MarketOrder(symbol, quantity, False, tag)
+        self.pending_orders[strategy] = ticket.OrderId
+        self.order_strategies[ticket.OrderId] = strategy
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _bar_or_none(data, symbol):
+        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
+            return data.Bars[symbol]
+        return None

        self.aapl = self.add_equity("AAPL", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.ibm = self.add_equity("IBM", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.bac = self.add_equity("BAC", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.aig = self.add_equity("AIG", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        # One extra SPY close is retained so both sides of an SMA cross can be
        # evaluated with fully formed 100-day averages.
        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=101)
        self.aapl_closes = deque(maxlen=4)
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS)

        # The two strategies own separate lots (and trade different symbols).
        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        bars = data.bars

        # Market-state quantities continue to consume every available bar even
        # on a date on which another subscribed ticker is missing.
        if bars.contains_key(self.spy):
            self.spy_closes.append(float(bars[self.spy].close))

        if bars.contains_key(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.close)
            if self.aapl_closes:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_closes[-1]:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.aapl_closes.append(aapl_close)
            self.aapl_rsi.update(aapl_bar.end_time, aapl_close)

        # No rule is evaluated unless every subscription supplied today's bar.
        if any(not bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        # No strategy trades until every indicator/window in the system is
        # fully formed. 101 SPY closes provide today's and yesterday's SMA.
        if (len(self.spy_closes) < 101 or len(self.aapl_closes) < 4
                or not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready):
            return

        spy_values = list(self.spy_closes)
        yesterday_close = spy_values[-2]
        today_close = spy_values[-1]
        yesterday_sma = sum(spy_values[:-1]) / 100.0
        today_sma = sum(spy_values[1:]) / 100.0
        spy_crossed_above = (yesterday_close <= yesterday_sma
                             and today_close > today_sma)
        spy_crossed_below = (yesterday_close >= yesterday_sma
                             and today_close < today_sma)

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if (self.strategy_b_shares > 0
                and float(self.aapl_rsi.current.value) > 60.0):
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value)
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / today_close))
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            cash_to_invest = 20_000.0
            if float(self.portfolio.cash) >= cash_to_invest:
                aapl_close = float(bars[self.aapl].close)
                quantity = int(math.floor(cash_to_invest / aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        previous_spy_close = self.spy_previous_close
        previous_spy_sma = self.spy_previous_sma
        current_spy_close = None
        current_spy_sma = None

        if spy in data.Bars:
            spy_bar = data.Bars[spy]
            current_spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            self.spy_closes.append(current_spy_close)

                current_spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0
            self.spy_previous_close = current_spy_close
            self.spy_previous_sma = current_spy_sma

        if aapl in data.Bars:

                if current_aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.aapl_previous_close = current_aapl_close
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, current_aapl_close)

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.spy_lot > 0:
            if (previous_spy_close is not None
                    and previous_spy_sma is not None
                    and current_spy_sma is not None
                    and previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma
                    and current_spy_close < current_spy_sma):
                self.MarketOrder(spy, -self.spy_lot)
                self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
                self.aapl_lot = 0

            if (previous_spy_close is not None
                    and previous_spy_sma is not None
                    and current_spy_sma is not None
                    and previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma
                    and current_spy_close > current_spy_sma):
                quantity = int(math.floor(
                    0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
                    / current_spy_close
                ))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(spy, quantity)
                    self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000:

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(aapl, quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol
            for ticker in self.tickers
        }

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](100)
        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS)
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        spy_symbol = self.symbols["SPY"]
        aapl_symbol = self.symbols["AAPL"]
        if not data.bars.contains_key(spy_symbol) or not data.bars.contains_key(aapl_symbol):
            return

        spy_bar = data.bars[spy_symbol]
        aapl_bar = data.bars[aapl_symbol]
        spy_close = float(spy_bar.close)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.close)

        self.spy_closes.add(spy_close)
        spy_sma = None
        if self.spy_closes.is_ready:
            spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(self.spy_closes.count)) / 100.0

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_rsi.update(aapl_bar.end_time, aapl_close)

        # Market state above is maintained continuously, but rules are evaluated
        # only for complete daily slices.
        if any(not data.bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.  Each quantity is the private lot
        # belonging to its strategy.
        if self.spy_lot > 0 and self._spy_crosses_below(spy_close, spy_sma):
            self.market_order(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
            self.market_order(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and self._spy_crosses_above(spy_close, spy_sma):
            quantity = int((0.40 * self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value) // spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

    def _spy_crosses_above(self, close, sma):
        return (
            sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and close > sma
        )

    def _spy_crosses_below(self, close, sma):
        return (
            sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and close < sma
        )

+from AlgorithmImports import *
+from collections import deque
+from math import floor
+
+
+class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
+    def Initialize(self):
+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.symbols = {}
+        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
+            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
+
+        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=101)
+        self.aapl_previous_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)
+
+        # Each entry is the share count belonging to that strategy alone.
+        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
+        self.strategy_b_shares = 0
+        self.strategy_a_order_pending = False
+        self.strategy_b_order_pending = False
+
+        # Supplies enough pre-start observations for both today's and yesterday's
+        # fully formed 100-day SMA values.
+        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)
+
+    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
+        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
+        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
+
+        # Corporate actions change the shares in a private lot just as they change
+        # the corresponding security holding.
+        if spy in data.Splits:
+            split = data.Splits[spy]
+            if split.SplitFactor != 0:
+                self.strategy_a_shares = int(round(self.strategy_a_shares / split.SplitFactor))
+        if aapl in data.Splits:
+            split = data.Splits[aapl]
+            if split.SplitFactor != 0:
+                self.strategy_b_shares = int(round(self.strategy_b_shares / split.SplitFactor))
+
+        bars = {}
+        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
+            if symbol in data.Bars:
+                bars[ticker] = data.Bars[symbol]
+
+        # Market-state quantities continue to consume every available ticker bar,
+        # even when another subscribed ticker is absent from this slice.
+        if "SPY" in bars:
+            self.spy_closes.append(float(bars["SPY"].Close))
+
+        if "AAPL" in bars:
+            aapl_bar = bars["AAPL"]
+            close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
+            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
+                if close < self.aapl_previous_close:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+                else:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.aapl_previous_close = close
+            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, close)
+
+        # A daily rule pass requires a current bar from every subscription.
+        if len(bars) != len(self.symbols) or self.IsWarmingUp:
+            return
+
+        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
+        self._evaluate_strategy_a_sell()
+        self._evaluate_strategy_b_sell()
+        self._evaluate_strategy_a_buy()
+        self._evaluate_strategy_b_buy()
+
+    def _spy_cross_values(self):
+        if len(self.spy_closes) < 101:
+            return None
+        closes = list(self.spy_closes)
+        yesterday_close = closes[-2]
+        today_close = closes[-1]
+        yesterday_sma = sum(closes[-101:-1]) / 100.0
+        today_sma = sum(closes[-100:]) / 100.0
+        return yesterday_close, yesterday_sma, today_close, today_sma
+
+    def _evaluate_strategy_a_sell(self):
+        if self.strategy_a_shares <= 0 or self.strategy_a_order_pending:
+            return
+        values = self._spy_cross_values()
+        if values is None:
+            return
+        yesterday_close, yesterday_sma, today_close, today_sma = values
+        if yesterday_close >= yesterday_sma and today_close < today_sma:
+            self.strategy_a_order_pending = True
+            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.strategy_a_shares, tag="Strategy A sell")
+
+    def _evaluate_strategy_b_sell(self):
+        if self.strategy_b_shares <= 0 or self.strategy_b_order_pending:
+            return
+        if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady and float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60.0:
+            self.strategy_b_order_pending = True
+            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.strategy_b_shares, tag="Strategy B sell")
+
+    def _evaluate_strategy_a_buy(self):
+        if self.strategy_a_shares != 0 or self.strategy_a_order_pending:
+            return
+        values = self._spy_cross_values()
+        if values is None:
+            return
+        yesterday_close, yesterday_sma, today_close, today_sma = values
+        if yesterday_close <= yesterday_sma and today_close > today_sma:
+            shares = floor((0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)) / today_close)
+            if shares > 0:
+                self.strategy_a_order_pending = True
+                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], shares, tag="Strategy A buy")
+
+    def _evaluate_strategy_b_buy(self):
+        if self.strategy_b_shares != 0 or self.strategy_b_order_pending:
+            return
+        if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000.0:
+            close = float(self.Securities[self.symbols["AAPL"]].Close)
+            shares = floor(20_000.0 / close)
+            if shares > 0:
+                self.strategy_b_order_pending = True
+                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], shares, tag="Strategy B buy")
+
+    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event: OrderEvent):
+        if order_event.Status not in (OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled,
+                                      OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
+            return
+
+        symbol = order_event.Symbol
+        if order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled):
+            fill_quantity = int(order_event.FillQuantity)
+            if symbol == self.symbols["SPY"]:
+                self.strategy_a_shares += fill_quantity
+            elif symbol == self.symbols["AAPL"]:
+                self.strategy_b_shares += fill_quantity
+
+        if order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
+            if symbol == self.symbols["SPY"]:
+                self.strategy_a_order_pending = False
+                self.strategy_a_shares = max(0, self.strategy_a_shares)
+            elif symbol == self.symbols["AAPL"]:
+                self.strategy_b_order_pending = False
+                self.strategy_b_shares = max(0, self.strategy_b_shares)

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
from math import floor


class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        # Separate strategy lots.  No strategy may sell shares owned by another.
        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        # Keep per-symbol state up to date even on a day when another symbol is
        # absent and the strategy rules therefore cannot be evaluated.
        self.closes = {ticker: deque(maxlen=101) for ticker in self.symbols}
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_previous_close = None

        # Wilder RSI state: 14 changes seed the averages; subsequent values use
        # Wilder's smoothing, matching LEAN's default RSI moving-average type.
        self.rsi_period = 14
        self.rsi_previous_close = None
        self.rsi_seed_gains = []
        self.rsi_seed_losses = []
        self.rsi_average_gain = None
        self.rsi_average_loss = None
        self.aapl_rsi = None

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = {}
        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                bars[ticker] = data.Bars[symbol]

        # Market-state quantities are updated continuously for every bar that
        # is present, regardless of whether all five bars arrived today.
        for ticker, bar in bars.items():
            close = float(bar.Close)
            self.closes[ticker].append(close)
            if ticker == "AAPL":
                self._update_aapl_state(close)

        # A missing bar for any subscription suppresses every rule for the day.
        if len(bars) != len(self.symbols):
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.spy_lot > 0 and self._spy_crosses_below_sma():
            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi is not None and self.aapl_rsi > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and self._spy_crosses_above_sma():
            close = float(bars["SPY"].Close)
            quantity = floor(0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            cash = float(self.Portfolio.Cash)
            if cash >= 20_000:
                close = float(bars["AAPL"].Close)
                quantity = floor(20_000 / close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

    def _spy_crosses_above_sma(self):
        closes = self.closes["SPY"]
        if len(closes) < 101:
            return False
        values = list(closes)
        yesterday_close = values[-2]
        today_close = values[-1]
        yesterday_sma = sum(values[-101:-1]) / 100
        today_sma = sum(values[-100:]) / 100
        return yesterday_close <= yesterday_sma and today_close > today_sma

    def _spy_crosses_below_sma(self):
        closes = self.closes["SPY"]
        if len(closes) < 101:
            return False
        values = list(closes)
        yesterday_close = values[-2]
        today_close = values[-1]
        yesterday_sma = sum(values[-101:-1]) / 100
        today_sma = sum(values[-100:]) / 100
        return yesterday_close >= yesterday_sma and today_close < today_sma

    def _update_aapl_state(self, close):
        if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
            if close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_previous_close = close

        if self.rsi_previous_close is None:
            self.rsi_previous_close = close
            return

        change = close - self.rsi_previous_close
        self.rsi_previous_close = close
        gain = max(change, 0.0)
        loss = max(-change, 0.0)

        if self.rsi_average_gain is None:
            self.rsi_seed_gains.append(gain)
            self.rsi_seed_losses.append(loss)
            if len(self.rsi_seed_gains) < self.rsi_period:
                return
            self.rsi_average_gain = sum(self.rsi_seed_gains) / self.rsi_period
            self.rsi_average_loss = sum(self.rsi_seed_losses) / self.rsi_period
        else:
            period = self.rsi_period
            self.rsi_average_gain = (
                self.rsi_average_gain * (period - 1) + gain
            ) / period
            self.rsi_average_loss = (
                self.rsi_average_loss * (period - 1) + loss
            ) / period

        if self.rsi_average_loss == 0:
            self.aapl_rsi = 100.0 if self.rsi_average_gain > 0 else 50.0
        else:
            relative_strength = self.rsi_average_gain / self.rsi_average_loss
            self.aapl_rsi = 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + relative_strength)

+

+            self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)

+                    )
+                    spy_crossed_below = (
+                        self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma
+                        and spy_close < spy_sma
+                    )
+                self.spy_previous_sma = spy_sma
+            self.spy_previous_close = spy_close
+
+        if "AAPL" in bars:
+            aapl_close = float(bars["AAPL"].Close)
+            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
+                change = aapl_close - self.aapl_previous_close
+                if change < 0:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+                else:

+                self._update_aapl_rsi(change)

+            self.aapl_loss_sum += loss
+            self.aapl_rsi_changes += 1

+                self.aapl_average_loss = self.aapl_loss_sum / 14.0
+                self.aapl_rsi = self._rsi_value(
+                    self.aapl_average_gain, self.aapl_average_loss
+                )
+            return
+
+        self.aapl_average_gain = (self.aapl_average_gain * 13.0 + gain) / 14.0
+        self.aapl_average_loss = (self.aapl_average_loss * 13.0 + loss) / 14.0
+        self.aapl_rsi = self._rsi_value(
+            self.aapl_average_gain, self.aapl_average_loss
+        )

+    @staticmethod
+    def _rsi_value(average_gain, average_loss):
+        if average_loss == 0.0:
+            if average_gain == 0.0:
+                return 50.0
+            return 100.0
+        relative_strength = average_gain / average_loss
+        return 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + relative_strength)

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
import math


class ParallelSpyAaplStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=101)
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.rsi_period = 14
        self.rsi_changes = 0
        self.rsi_gain_sum = 0.0
        self.rsi_loss_sum = 0.0
        self.rsi_average_gain = None
        self.rsi_average_loss = None
        self.aapl_rsi = None

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        bars = data.bars

        # Keep private share counts aligned with LEAN's split adjustment of the
        # corresponding security holdings.
        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
        if spy in data.splits and self.spy_lot > 0:
            self.spy_lot = round(self.spy_lot / float(data.splits[spy].split_factor))
        if aapl in data.splits and self.aapl_lot > 0:
            self.aapl_lot = round(
                self.aapl_lot / float(data.splits[aapl].split_factor)
            )

        # Market-state values continue to advance whenever their ticker has data,
        # even if another subscription is missing and trading must be skipped.
        if spy in bars:
            self.spy_closes.append(float(bars[spy].close))
        if aapl in bars:
            self._update_aapl_state(float(bars[aapl].close))

        if any(symbol not in bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        # Every indicator/window used anywhere in the system must be fully formed.
        if len(self.spy_closes) < 101 or self.aapl_rsi is None:
            return

        spy_close = float(bars[spy].close)
        aapl_close = float(bars[aapl].close)
        spy_sma_yesterday = sum(list(self.spy_closes)[:100]) / 100.0
        spy_sma_today = sum(list(self.spy_closes)[1:]) / 100.0
        spy_close_yesterday = self.spy_closes[99]

        spy_crossed_below = (
            spy_close_yesterday >= spy_sma_yesterday
            and spy_close < spy_sma_today
        )
        spy_crossed_above = (
            spy_close_yesterday <= spy_sma_yesterday
            and spy_close > spy_sma_today
        )

        # All sells are evaluated before either strategy's buy.
        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.market_order(spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi > 60.0:
            self.market_order(aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            quantity = math.floor(
                0.40 * float(self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value) / spy_close
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(spy, quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            cash_to_invest = 20_000.0
            if float(self.portfolio.cash) >= cash_to_invest:
                quantity = math.floor(cash_to_invest / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(aapl, quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

    def _update_aapl_state(self, close):
        if self.aapl_previous_close is None:
            self.aapl_previous_close = close
            return

        change = close - self.aapl_previous_close
        self.aapl_red_streak = self.aapl_red_streak + 1 if change < 0 else 0
        gain = max(change, 0.0)
        loss = max(-change, 0.0)

        if self.rsi_changes < self.rsi_period:
            self.rsi_gain_sum += gain
            self.rsi_loss_sum += loss
            self.rsi_changes += 1
            if self.rsi_changes == self.rsi_period:
                self.rsi_average_gain = self.rsi_gain_sum / self.rsi_period
                self.rsi_average_loss = self.rsi_loss_sum / self.rsi_period
                self.aapl_rsi = self._rsi_value()
        else:
            self.rsi_average_gain = (
                self.rsi_average_gain * (self.rsi_period - 1) + gain
            ) / self.rsi_period
            self.rsi_average_loss = (
                self.rsi_average_loss * (self.rsi_period - 1) + loss
            ) / self.rsi_period
            self.aapl_rsi = self._rsi_value()

        self.aapl_previous_close = close

    def _rsi_value(self):
        if self.rsi_average_loss == 0:
            return 50.0 if self.rsi_average_gain == 0 else 100.0
        relative_strength = self.rsi_average_gain / self.rsi_average_loss
        return 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + relative_strength)

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # These securities have one owner each, so the holdings are the exact
        # private-lot sizes (and automatically reflect fills and split changes).
        self.spy_lot = int(self.Portfolio[spy].Quantity)
        self.aapl_lot = int(self.Portfolio[aapl].Quantity)

        spy_bar = data.Bars[spy] if spy in data.Bars else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[aapl] if aapl in data.Bars else None

        # Market-state quantities continue to advance whenever their ticker has a bar,
        # even on a day on which another subscription is missing.
        spy_ready_before_update = self.spy_sma.IsReady
        if spy_bar is not None:
            old_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
            old_spy_sma = self.previous_spy_sma
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)

        else:
            old_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
            old_spy_sma = self.previous_spy_sma
            today_spy_sma = None

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        all_bars_present = all(
            symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()

                and old_spy_close is not None
                and old_spy_sma is not None

                and old_spy_sma is not None
                and old_spy_close <= old_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > today_spy_sma
            )

                quantity = math.floor(
                    0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_bar.Close
                )
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(spy, quantity)

            self.previous_spy_sma = today_spy_sma
        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque


class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.rsi_change_count = 0
        self.rsi_initial_gain = 0.0
        self.rsi_initial_loss = 0.0
        self.rsi_average_gain = None
        self.rsi_average_loss = None
        self.aapl_rsi = None

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = data.Bars
        available = {symbol: bars[symbol] for symbol in self.symbols if bars.ContainsKey(symbol)}

        if self.spy in available:
            self._update_spy(available[self.spy].Close)
        if self.aapl in available:
            self._update_aapl(available[self.aapl].Close)

        if len(available) != len(self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = float(available[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(available[self.aapl].Close)

        # Both independent slots evaluate their sell rule before their buy rule.
        if self.spy_lot > 0:
            if self._spy_crossed_below(spy_close):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
                self.spy_lot = 0
        elif self._spy_crossed_above(spy_close):
            quantity = int((float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40) // spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot > 0:
            if self.aapl_rsi is not None and self.aapl_rsi > 60.0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
                self.aapl_lot = 0
        elif self.aapl_rsi is not None and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000.0:
                quantity = int(20_000.0 // aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

        close = float(close)
        current_sma = None
        if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
            current_sma = (sum(self.spy_closes) - self.spy_closes[0] + close) / 100.0

        self.spy_closes.append(close)
        if current_sma is None and len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
            current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0

        self.previous_spy_close = getattr(self, "current_spy_close", None)
        self.previous_spy_sma = getattr(self, "current_spy_sma", None)
        self.current_spy_close = close
        self.current_spy_sma = current_sma

    def _update_aapl(self, close):
        close = float(close)
        if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = close
            return

        change = close - self.previous_aapl_close
        self.aapl_red_streak = self.aapl_red_streak + 1 if change < 0 else 0
        gain = max(change, 0.0)
        loss = max(-change, 0.0)

        if self.rsi_change_count < 14:
            self.rsi_initial_gain += gain
            self.rsi_initial_loss += loss
            self.rsi_change_count += 1
            if self.rsi_change_count == 14:
                self.rsi_average_gain = self.rsi_initial_gain / 14.0
                self.rsi_average_loss = self.rsi_initial_loss / 14.0
        else:
            self.rsi_average_gain = (self.rsi_average_gain * 13.0 + gain) / 14.0
            self.rsi_average_loss = (self.rsi_average_loss * 13.0 + loss) / 14.0

        if self.rsi_average_gain is not None:
            if self.rsi_average_loss == 0.0:
                self.aapl_rsi = 100.0
            else:
                relative_strength = self.rsi_average_gain / self.rsi_average_loss
                self.aapl_rsi = 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + relative_strength)

        self.previous_aapl_close = close

    def _spy_crossed_above(self, close):
        return (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.current_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and close > self.current_spy_sma
        )

    def _spy_crossed_below(self, close):
        return (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.current_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and close < self.current_spy_sma
        )

from math import floor


class DailyMultiStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)
        self.RegisterIndicator(self.aapl, self.aapl_rsi, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = {}
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        current_spy_sma = None
        if self.spy in bars:
            self.spy_closes.append(float(bars[self.spy].Close))
            if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
                current_spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0

        if self.aapl in bars:
            aapl_close = float(bars[self.aapl].Close)
            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        all_bars_present = len(bars) == len(self.symbols)
        indicators_ready = current_spy_sma is not None and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady

        if all_bars_present and indicators_ready:
            spy_close = float(bars[self.spy].Close)
            aapl_close = float(bars[self.aapl].Close)

            spy_crossed_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < current_spy_sma
            )
            spy_crossed_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > current_spy_sma
            )

            if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
                quantity = self.CalculateOrderQuantity(self.spy, 0.40)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                cash = self.Portfolio.CashBook["USD"].Amount
                if cash >= 20_000:
                    quantity = floor(20_000 / aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:

                        self.strategy_b_shares = quantity
